p10_b0.ocr: In the Infrastructure Investment Report for FY2023, total investment amounts to $24,000,000, representing 100% of the budget, with an overall rating of B+ and challenges faced including regulatory delays.

p10_b1.ocr: The report categorizes investments as follows: Campus Facilities received $5,000,000, marked as completed with an A rating; Online Education, $3,000,000, classified as in progress; Technology Upgrades, $2,000,000, also in progress; Student Housing, $8,000,000, completed with an A+ rating; Library Renovation, $1,000,000, in progress with a B+ rating; Sports Facilities, $4,000,000, planned with a B rating; Research Labs, $6,000,000, completed with an A- rating; IT Infrastructure, $2,500,000, in progress; Green Initiatives, $1,500,000, planned with a B rating; and Transport Services, $1,200,000, completed with an A rating.
